peer_lane_frozen.note: Cycle-J serum lane is unaffected by serum_h_v1. The two are governance-separate peer lanes, not parent/child.

anchor_dataset.name: NHANES 2013-2014 PFAS Special Subsample (cycle H)
anchor_dataset.method: online SPE-HPLC-TIS-MS/MS (Kuklenyik 2005); same method family as cycle J

column_naming_convention: snake_case (janitor::clean_names applied to raw NHANES SAS names; identical pipeline to serum v1.0)

required_columns.name: wtsb2yr
required_columns.units: respondents per 2-year subsample (cycle-H surplus-serum subsample weight)

lod_code_semantics.0: at or above LOD; reported value is the measured concentration
lod_code_semantics.1: below LOD; reported value is imputed by NHANES at LOD / sqrt(2) ~= 0.0707 ng/mL (constant across analytes in cycle H)

label_unit_reconciliation.numerical_equivalence: 1 ug/L == 1 ng/mL for aqueous matrix to within ~2.5% (serum density ~1.025 g/mL).
label_unit_reconciliation.anchor_csv_values_recorded_as: ng/mL (raw numerical values from PFAS_H.XPT; no unit conversion applied)
label_unit_reconciliation.enforcement: Ingestion code MUST treat values as ng/mL, MUST record the upstream label discrepancy in the audit log when source is PFAS_H.XPT, and MUST refuse any double-conversion (relabel as ug/L AND multiply by a conversion factor).

must_not_be_combined_with: serum (cycle J, different analyte panel; cross-cycle joins require a documented harmonization artifact)
matrix_isolation.rationale: Each matrix carries its own analytical method, unit system, sampling frame, and regulatory framing. Cross-matrix and cross-cycle combination require explicit harmonization and are not authorized by this contract.
matrix_isolation.enforcement: Lane ingestion code MUST reject any input row that simultaneously carries a serum_h analyte value and a column from any environmental matrix or from the cycle-J serum lane without a documented harmonization.

refusal_conditions: Input not derived from human serum biomonitoring
Source cycle is not NHANES H (2013-2014) without paired harmonization artifact
Concentration outside the observed envelope by more than 3 sigma without batch metadata
Units other than ng/mL without explicit reconciliation against schema_contract.md §3.2
Row claims an isomer-resolved PFOA/PFOS analyte (n-PFOA, Sb-PFOA, n-PFOS, Sm-PFOS) without SSPFAS_H.XPT being co-admitted

SSPFAS_H_2013_2014.role: Surplus-serum companion carrying the n-/Sb- PFOA and n-/Sm- PFOS isomer split for NHANES cycle H. Conversion to CSV is not yet admitted under serum_h_v1.
SSPFAS_H_2013_2014.status: Recorded paired non-admitted artifact (SHA-256 captured in provenance.md). Admission requires a follow-up review (see schema_contract.md §7.1).

out_of_scope_versions.PFAS_J_2017_2018: Already governed by validation/serum_v1/ (frozen anchor SHA-256 dfd4dbb5...). Cross-cycle merging requires a separate harmonization artifact.
out_of_scope_versions.P_PFAS_prepandemic_2017_2020: Requires its own serum_prepandemic_v1 lane; not covered by serum_h_v1.
out_of_scope_versions.L06AGE_C_2003_2004_legacy: Requires its own serum_c_v1 lane; not covered by serum_h_v1.
out_of_scope_versions.PFAS_I_2015_2016: Requires its own serum_i_v1 lane; not covered by serum_h_v1.

physiological_classification.scope: lane-specific; this stamp applies only to the serum_h lane (schema_contract.md §9.1) and MUST NOT be borrowed by environmental, reference-material, or cycle-J serum rows

field_notes.source_program: Source-program coordinate (issuing agency + dataset family). The specific cycle (H) is captured by the source_dataset value in the canonical core, not duplicated here.
field_notes.governance_lane: The (pipeline_id, governance_version) coordinate that points back to validation/serum_h_v1/. Distinct from cycle-J's serum_v1 value; do not interchange.
field_notes.units_excluded: Concentration units are a row property handled by schema_contract.md §3.2 (label-unit reconciliation), not duplicated as a lane-stamped constant.

guard.enforcement_layer: row-level (validate / normalize / save / train must all call the physiological guard before admitting a row to the serum_h lane)

physiological_classification.build_pipeline_integration_status: draft: not yet wired into scripts/run_matrix_pipeline.py or LatestPFAS.R PHYSIOLOGICAL_LANE_STAMPS. The lane is governance-only until a follow-up artifact wires (a) a pipeline_id in data/config/matrix_pipeline_sop.csv, (b) data/training/serum_h/manifest.json, (c) data/ad_models/serum_h/ad_model.json, and (d) extends PHYSIOLOGICAL_LANE_STAMPS to include serum_h with this exact stamp.
